messages:
alex: Noticed a spike in SSO failures after last night's IdP cert rotation. Symptoms: SAML signature verify errors on some nodes and SCIM deprov 403s for a subset of tenants.

mira: Which IdP and any recent infra/name changes?

alex: Okta rotation. We also merged tenant-id normalization (short -> canonical -org) this week.

sam: SCIM logs show 403 with unwrap failure: 

sam: ```
403 Forbidden - key_unwrap_failed
{"reason":"kms:context_mismatch","expected":"tenant:acme-org","got":"tenant:acme"}
```

jordan: That looks like two issues: (1) some edges had stale IdP cert cache -> signature verify fails; (2) legacy wrapped keys still use old tenant ctx -> KMS unwrap rejects.

idp-bot: :information_source: Okta cert rotate completed at 00:12 UTC. Thumbprint: 0xC3D4...

ops-bot: Checking edge caches... edge-11 had stale fingerprint 0xB2A1..., forcing refresh now.

ops-bot: edge-11 refreshed at 00:30 UTC, new fingerprint 0xC3D4...

mira: After refresh SAML verification succeeded on that node. For SCIM, debug shows wrappedKey.header ctx still using legacy short id. SCIM's KMS client bypasses alias translation.

priya: Short-term: add a compat hook in SCIM to accept legacy ctx values for unwrap. Medium-term: rewrap migration to canonical ctx plus audit trail.

sam: Deprov dry-run with compat hook passed in staging. Will canary to prod.

alex: Follow-ups: export list of wrapped keys with legacy ctx (for compliance), schedule rewrap job (with operator audit), and add a provisioning probe to detect NameID format changes.

jordan: I'll draft RFC for rewrap + compliance logging. Include threat model: possible DoS via induced ctx mismatch.

mira: Notifying legal/compliance about planned rewrap and audit retention. Keeping thread open until migration completed.

ops-bot: Incident record created: SSO-OKTA-ROTATE-2026-03 status=mitigated owner=mira followups=[REWRAP-2026,RFC-1433]
